title: Governance & policy-as-code
summary: Module 8. Make security expressible and auditable. Replace the always-allow policy stub with a real engine that gates every action by blast radius, denies external egress, and writes a queryable audit trail.
takeaway: Security that lives in scattered if-statements can't be audited. Make it policy-as-code with an audit trail.
design_rule: Evaluate every action against a decision matrix by blast radius; log who/what/decision/why/when.
